FAQs
items.html:
What makes this Kids Electric Toothbrush different from a regular toothbrush?
This kids electric tooth brush uses gentle sonic vibrations and soft, tapered bristles to clean effectively without hurting sensitive gums. It also features multiple brushing modes and a built-in timer to help children develop healthy oral care habits from an early age.
Is this toothbrush safe for children to use?
Yes! This children’s electric toothbrush is specifically designed for kids ages 6 and up. It’s lightweight, easy to grip, and uses soft bristles that provide a gentle, comfortable brushing experience while promoting kids dental hygiene.
How long does the battery last on this rechargeable toothbrush?
The Supermouth kids rechargeable toothbrush offers long-lasting battery life and includes a convenient USB charger. A full charge can last several days, making it perfect for both home use and travel.
How often should I replace the brush head?
For best results and hygiene, we recommend replacing the brush head every three months — or sooner if the bristles appear worn. This ensures your child’s kids electric toothbrush continues to deliver optimal cleaning performance.
What brushing modes are included?
This childrens electric toothbrush features three modes: Clean, Sensitive, and Massage. Each brush mode lasts for two minutes to encourage proper brushing time and consistent kids oral hygiene routines.
Can younger kids use this toothbrush with supervision?
While the kids electric toothbrush is recommended for ages 6 and above, younger children may use it under adult supervision. Parents can assist to ensure safe handling and correct brushing technique for better dental care.
How does this toothbrush help build better brushing habits?
The built-in two-minute timer and fun, vibrating design make brushing time engaging and effective. This helps kids stay consistent with their oral care routine while enjoying the process — turning everyday brushing into a healthy habit.

items.quote: “SuperMouth, a Good Housekeeping Parenting Awards winner, makes oral care fun for kids with superhero—and supervillain—themed toothbrushes that are exciting for children. Our pros in the Parenting Lab were impressed by the three speeds and intensities (light clean, super clean, and massage) and the gentle bristles that are soft on young gums, which means brushing will be a more comfortable experience for kids. reviews.name: Christinatdodds
reviews.body: My son loves to dance to the tunes of SuperMouth. We have transformed our bedtime routine from a chore to a playtime. Brushing and flossing was always met with resistance and tears from my son. But luckily for our family we discovered SuperMouth, and my son has found a new passion in brushing. He loves the characters on his toothbrush, the flavors for his toothpaste, and his tongue brush. As a dentist and parent, I love the healthy ingredients that SuperMouth provides. I am thrilled to combine healthy dental products with a happy toddler who loves to take care of his teeth!
